name: ai.zensation/zenbrain
title: ZenBrain Memory
description: Agent memory: working, episodic, semantic, procedural and core layers. Local SQLite, no account.

environmentVariables.name: ZENBRAIN_DB
environmentVariables.description: Path to the SQLite file that holds the memory. A leading ~/ means your home directory; a relative path depends on where the client starts the server (some start it in /), so give an absolute or ~/ path. Use ':memory:' for a store that is discarded when the process exits.

environmentVariables.name: ZENBRAIN_CONTEXTS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated context domains, passed to the cross-context layer. No tool uses that layer yet, so the value currently has no effect.
